title: Pan-Seared Polish Duck Breast with Honey Gratin
description: Tender Polish duck breast pan-seared to perfection and served with a sweet honey gratin.
instructions: Season the duck breast with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck breast for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the duck reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Meanwhile, prepare the honey gratin according to the package instructions.
Remove the duck from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the duck breast with the honey gratin spooned over the top.
